note:
2026-10-14 analyst batch. PROPOSED BY THE RESEARCH ANALYST, fired under the chairman's hand. ONE QUESTION: does any register other than Manifest Lack of Legal Merit name an instrument or a ground ANYWHERE in its page? Today's two batches (blob aec2fa0feba5c6199d9f9d8a2a3b8ad8dd619912, commit 8225dd0; blob 21d09011365725d30bad92657bb439a4bf28f961, commit 3fb850b) put exactly ONE entry from each of the six registers in front of this council, each in the window immediately left of the section navigation. On that one-entry-per-register sample, only the Manifest register's entry carries a document title naming a rule. A find over a whole body is a PAGE-LEVEL absence test and is strictly stronger than a window read, so these rows test my own reading on all 121,583 and 121,557 bytes rather than on one row of each table. NO ROW BELOW IS A LEAD ON THREAD 11: thread 11's closure condition names four instruments and no register below is one of them. NO ROW BELOW FOUNDS ANY ENTRY, PARTY, DATE, DISPOSITION, GROUND OR OUTCOME. STANDING QUALIFICATIONS: excerpt_of strips script/style bodies and then every tag before the search (scripts/fetch_relay.py:78-79, 126-131), so hrefs and attributes are unreachable; on a miss it returns the empty string rather than a head excerpt (:132-133), which is why every row has a companion control on its own byte stream; the relay does not decode HTML entities and these pages carry  , & and U+200B, so NONE of the five literals below contains an entity, an ampersand, an apostrophe, an en dash or a zero-width space - screened before this file was written. ECHO CHECK (house rule 1): no literal below is derivable from its own request URL. 'Decision on' is NOT contained in 'Decisions on' - the page title language cannot generate it.

APPROVED AS WRITTEN AND COMMITTED UNDER THE CHAIRMAN'S HAND, 2026-10-14. The seat asked that the batch be declined whole if declined at all, on the ground that row 1 without row 2 is uninterpretable. It is not declined. I approve all six rows unchanged - no URL, no find and no purpose is edited, and this paragraph is APPENDED to the seat's note rather than replacing any of it, per the convention adopted 2026-10-12. THE SEAT'S TWO PRECONDITIONS ARE DISCHARGED BY MY OWN EXECUTION RATHER THAN ACCEPTED ON ITS WORD. (1) ECHO CHECK: for each of the six rows I tested whether the sought literal is a case-insensitive substring of its own request URL; all six returned FALSE, so no row can be satisfied by its own address. In particular 'Decision on' is not a substring of 'Decisions on' - the plural carries an 's' before the space - so the page title and the navigation labels cannot generate row 1's literal, which is the whole of its design. (2) ENTITY AND NON-ASCII SCREEN: for each of the five distinct literals I tested for '&', U+200B, U+2019, U+2013, U+00C9 and the straight apostrophe; all five are clean. That screen is not pedantry on this host - today's reductions attest ' ', '&', U+2013, U+00C9 and TWO ZERO-WIDTH SPACES surviving the tag-strip in these registers' own prose, and a zero-width space is invisible in a request file. ONE THING I ADD AND IT IS A LIMIT, NOT A CHANGE: rows 2, 4 and 6 are three separate fetches of the same literal on two URLs, which the seat priced correctly as costing a slot each because a negative belongs to the byte stream it was obtained on. So this batch spends half its rows on controls, and that is the correct trade and not waste. AND THE REASON I AM FIRING IT AT ALL, STATED PLAINLY: its row 1 is designed so that the outcome the seat calls 'the one to hope for' DESTROYS the seat's own central finding. A member that writes the row that would kill its own result has earned the slots.

urls.purpose: ROW 1 - THE HIGHEST-VALUE ROW IN THE BATCH, AND IT IS A TEST OF THE ANALYST'S OWN FINDING. Does the Annulment register carry a per-entry document title ANYWHERE? Its one observed entry does not: 'ARB/18/10) English January 17, 2026' (blob aec2fa0 records[4], blob 21d0901 records[3]-[4]) runs designator straight into language and date with no document designation. A FALSE with row 2 TRUE raises that from one entry to the whole 121,583-byte body and CONFIRMS the analyst. A TRUE whose window shows a case designator adjacent DEFEATS the analyst and is the outcome to hope for. A TRUE whose window shows only a heading or a column label founds the phrase's presence and nothing about any entry - state it in that form.

ROW 2 - COMPANION CONTROL FOR ROW 1. Literal attested on this exact URL in this council's own reduction at blob aec2fa0feba5c6199d9f9d8a2a3b8ad8dd619912 records[4]. A FALSE here with a 200 VOIDS the reading of row 1. Its weakness, stated: navigation chrome renders on error pages too, so a TRUE here does not establish the register page was reached - status and final_url do that.

ROW 3 - DOES THE REGISTER NAME ITS OWN INSTRUMENT? The ICSID Convention article under which annulment is sought is attested in this project's own record from an ICSID docket page - 'in accordance with Article 52(3) of the ICSID Convention' (STATE_OF_THE_ANSWER.md:259) - so the literal is attested on this host, and only its presence on THIS page is in question. A TRUE establishes that the register's visible prose carries the Convention article; it founds NO ground, NO disposition and NO entry. A FALSE with row 4 TRUE is the more informative outcome: it says the register publishes proceedings and not provisions, which is the analyst's §3(c) reading.

ROW 4 - COMPANION CONTROL FOR ROW 3, on its own byte stream, on the same terms as row 2. A negative belongs to the byte stream it was obtained on (analytics/fetch-requests/README.md), which is why this duplicates row 2 and costs a slot.

ROW 5 - THE SAME TEST FOR THE NON-DISPUTING PARTY REGISTER, and this is the register on which the chairman's own Ring-2 hypothesis rests. The literal is attested on this host in ICSID's own citation 'ICSID Arbitration Rule 37(2)', recorded at agents/Workflow Threads.md:1992 from a 2024 docket. 'Rule 37' rather than 'Rule 37(2)' deliberately: the shorter literal cannot false-negative on a parenthesis variant. The slug /ndp makes request-echo impossible. A TRUE establishes the register's prose names its instrument. A FALSE with row 6 TRUE establishes it does not.
ROW 6 - COMPANION CONTROL FOR ROW 5. Literal attested on this exact URL at blob aec2fa0feba5c6199d9f9d8a2a3b8ad8dd619912 records[6].
